summary: Session 94 live-Preview backend verification of Doc #54 (Volunteer QRs) and Doc #55 (truthful consumer send-otp). 13/13 pytest tests pass against https://mall-engagement-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Safety rules followed: only 9999999999 and 7000700071 used for OTP, and 7000700071 send-otp was called exactly once (200, delivery whatsapp=accepted, sms=accepted). Blocked-phone test used a blocked_phones entry, which returns 403 before any OTP is stored or sent. No /admin/otp/send-test, no bill routes, no app code changed.

minor.issue: This path does not exist and returns 404, not 500. The platform_counts endpoint is actually GET /api/admin/app-download-qr/stats, which returns 200 with a platform_counts dict. The review request used the wrong path name.
The response is {users:[...], total, skip, limit}, not a bare array. The users field is an array, as the existing admin UI expects.

action_items: None blocking. If needed, correct the stats endpoint name in docs or the handoff to /api/admin/app-download-qr/stats.
critical_code_review_comments: consumer.py send-otp: the blocked check comes before the reviewer bypass, and the reviewer bypass comes before store_otp/send_login_otp, so the reviewer path never reaches a gateway. Verified: no delivery key in the response.

If send_login_otp raises (instead of returning a dict) the route gives an unhandled 500 rather than a 503. send_otp_whatsapp/sms are believed to catch internally, but wrapping the await in try/except and returning 503 would be more robust.
verify-otp dev bypass (1234) leaves the stored otp_codes record in place (attempts=0). This is pre-existing behaviour and unchanged by #55.

The delivery_last/delivery_failed stamp is confirmed on the Preview otp_codes record for 7000700071: whatsapp=accepted, sms=accepted, channel_policy=both, delivery_failed=false. The OTP value is not overwritten.
seed_data_creation: None. A single OTP record for 7000700071 was refreshed by the one send-otp call.
